comments.title: "Unrepresentable" page means its offset overflows Hibernate's int
comments.anchor: private static final int MAX_PAGE = Integer.MAX_VALUE / 20;
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.70 — "Unrepresentable" page means its offset overflows Hibernate's int

**Not taken:** Accept any int page and let a huge offset fail at query time

**Why:** The spec (specs/owner-list/spec.md:23) demands a 400 for unrepresentable pages without defining the term. Capping at MAX_INT/20 is the tightest bound that holds at every allowed size, but a lower business cap would be equally defensible.

comments.title: Invalid parameters rejected by bean validation plus a @OneOf constraint
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.75 — Invalid parameters rejected by bean validation plus a @OneOf constraint

**Not taken:** A custom exception that rest throws and rest.error maps

**Why:** packages.puml forbids rest → rest.error, so a custom exception would need an architecture change. Spring's own HandlerMethodValidationException keeps both packages independent; the cost is one small constraint annotation.

comments.title: Type-mismatch 400 applies to every REST endpoint, not only the list
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.60 — Type-mismatch 400 applies to every REST endpoint, not only the list

**Not taken:** Scope the 400 to listOwners and keep 500 elsewhere

**Why:** The spec needs page=abc to return 400, and a 500 for malformed input is wrong everywhere. Still, /api/owners/abc changing from 500 to 400 is a contract change nobody asked for.

comments.title: Allowed sizes and the sort default stated in OpenAPI descriptions
comments.anchor: + "The direction applies to every field. Defaults to name,asc.",
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.60 — Allowed sizes and the sort default stated in OpenAPI descriptions

**Not taken:** A custom OpenAPI customizer emitting an integer enum and default

**Why:** springdoc renders allowableValues as strings, which Spectral rejects, and drops a default that contains a comma. Prose keeps the lint green, but machines cannot read the 5/10/20 rule from the schema.

comments.title: A failure hides the grid instead of keeping stale rows
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.55 — A failure hides the grid instead of keeping stale rows

**Not taken:** Keep the last rows visible under the error banner

**Why:** The spec says a failure must not look like a result, and stale rows under a new query would. Showing the previous rows greyed out is a reasonable UX that the spec does not exclude.

comments.title: An empty page within a non-empty result shows a "go back" row
comments.anchor: This page is empty — go back to an earlier page.
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.65 — An empty page within a non-empty result shows a "go back" row

**Not taken:** Jump to the last valid page automatically

**Why:** The spec only forbids claiming "no matches" and requires navigation to stay available. Auto-jumping would send an extra request nobody triggered.
